description: Coastal BC Marine Industrial Sites is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoBC Branch. The locations of coastal British Columbia industrial sites. The Coastal BC datasets are circa 2004 and legacy in nature. Caution should be exercised when using this data, as it may not be accurate or complete. There are currently no plans to update. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher GeoBC Branch. Its tags are coast, industrial, industry. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2025-05-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
